snippets.ADOPT: Are you sure you want to choose this pony? You can only adopt one horse and cannot change your choice later.
snippets.BRUSH_HELP: Take care of your horse! Wash it, brush it, feed it well so it can participate in the races. Take the brush to brush your horse. Press your finger on the left mouse button and move the cursor in circles in order to brush his coat and make it shiny.
snippets.CARE_HELP: Take care of your horse! Wash it, brush it, feed it well so it can participate in the races. To feed your horse, press you finger on the left mouse button and drag a carrot or an apple to it's mouth. To stroke or pat your horse, press your finger on the left mouse button over the hand symbol and drag it over to wear you want to pat your horse.
snippets.COMB_HELP: Take care of your horse! Wash it, brush it, feed it well so it can participate in the races. Take the comb using the left mouse button and comb the mane and tail of your horse. Use long sweeping strokes to make sure there are no tangles. You can only use the comb for your horse's mane and tail.
snippets.HORSE_CARE_INSTRUCTION: Take care of your horse! Wash it, brush it, feed it well so it can participate in the races. To feed your horse, press you finger on the left mouse button and drag a carrot or an apple to it's mouth. To stroke or pat your horse, press your finger on the left mouse button over the hand symbol and drag it over to wear you want to pat your horse. Take the comb using the left mouse button and comb the mane and tail of your horse. Use long sweeping strokes to make sure there are no tangles. You can only use the comb for your horse's mane and tail. Take the brush to brush your horse. Press your finger on the left mouse button and move the cursor in circles in order to brush his coat and make it shiny.
snippets.HORSE_RACE_INSTRUCTION: If your horse is happy and healthy, it can win many prizes by participating in horse racing. Remember to reach the finish line before the time runs out. To start the race, click on your horse once. Use the arrow keys to move your horse. Click the up arrow to make your horse jump. The more difficult the level you choose, the longer the race tracks will be and the less time you will have to complete the race. There are more obstacles to overcome in the more difficult levels, but you can earn more bonus points there, too!
snippets.LIVES_END: Sorry, you have no more lives left. Try again.
snippets.RACE_HELP: If your horse is happy and healthy, it can win many prizes by participating in horse racing. Remember to reach the finish line before the time runs out. Use the arrow keys to move your horse. Press your finger on the right button of your mouse to start the race and maintain your speed. Press your finger on the left button of your mouse to slow down. Click the up arrow to make your horse jump. The higher the level that you choose, the more difficult the course will be and the less time you have to complete the race. There are many obstacles which you need to overcome and can earn bonus points!
snippets.TIME_OVER: Sorry, time has run out! Try again.
snippets.WIN_RACE: Congratulations! You have finished the race!
